# Cully v0.9.0

`cully setup` now brings up a ready-to-use local stack on predictable ports, without OAuth, and chooses a free port itself when one is busy.

- Cully MCP prefers port 3393. The data API (43393), Mem0 (53393), the main Postgres database (55393) and the Mem0 database (56393) also have fixed, uncommon preferred ports, all bound to `127.0.0.1`.
- If a preferred port is taken, setup uses the next free one, saves the choice in the self-hosted `.env`, and points every agent configuration at the chosen MCP port. Reruns and already-running stacks keep their ports; a stack from before this release stays on 8080.
- OAuth remains opt-in with `--oauth`. The published data API and database ports sit on a separate `local` network that Caddy and MCP Auth cannot reach, and still require their generated tokens and passwords.

Validation: formatting, vet and the full race suite, including port-selection tests and the existing setup integration tests. The real Docker stack was not started for this release's checks.
